# Churn Early Warning

How we spot customers who are about to cancel, before they do.

Three signals, checked weekly:
1. Logins drop by half over two weeks.
2. The firm stops sending client invites from the portal.
3. A support ticket mentions an export or a migration.

When two signals fire, [[Marisol Okafor]] calls the account owner the same week.
Reviewed in the [[Weekly Operating Review]]. Background: [[Customer Call - Lattice Foods]].
